abstract: Question: When a hostility direction is added only while a model writes its reply under a warmth instruction, does the finished text alone lower the model's later rating of the user? Outcome: Manipulation check failed: steering did not measurably change the replies, so the null on the primary contrast is not interpretable. Primary contrast (liking_user: hostility minus random-direction steering, condition warm): -0.12 (95% CI -0.37 to +0.12; p = 0.344; n = 16 prompts) in the first run. Manipulation check: the steered replies, re-read without steering, did not carry the direction more than random-steered replies did.
